tools.name: mitosis_connect_agent
tools.description: Get instructions to connect an existing AI agent to Mitosis memory. Returns the SDK install command and the URL of the full connect guide (trust envelope → install SDK → mi login → mi cortex manifest → mi connect).

tools.name: mitosis_get_pricing
tools.description: Get Mitosis subscription plans and prices (Solo, Team, Scale, Business). Returns each plan’s monthly price, included seats, and monthly credit allowance, plus the annual discount and links to subscribe. Live pricing is shown on the /billing page.

tools.name: mitosis_navigate
tools.description: Navigate to a section of the Mitosis website. Returns the resolved URL. Use `mitosis_overview` first if unsure which pages exist.

page.description: home: Homepage; graph: The memory graph — your agents’ source of truth; pricing: Pricing and plans; signup: Create an account / start a free trial; login: Sign in; docs: Documentation; backups: Agent workspace backups; blog: Blog; about: About Mitosis

tools.name: mitosis_overview
tools.description: Get a summary of what Mitosis is and where to find more. Mitosis builds one verified source of truth from everything you know and connects every AI agent to it. Returns a product summary and links to documentation, the agent-skills index, and the connect guide.

tools.name: mitosis_sign_up
tools.description: Start creating a Mitosis account (free to begin). Navigates the browser to the sign-up page. Optionally pass a plan slug (solo, team, scale, or business) to preselect it.
